info.description:
This practicum course is designed to give students the opportunity to apply theoretical knowledge learned before to actual multimedia production situations. This course incorporates in its approach a combination of applied media aesthetics theory and hands-on production experience in Video production. Students will gain a foundation for understanding media production theory, facilitating video production processes as well as creating and evaluating media products relating to a particular issue set by the course lecturer. A component of the course will permit the introduction of current topics such as media issues, professional video production techniques, changing media technology, and job market information.

As a student of the class, you will sample a variety of production work through active team participation. Based on the quality of the video, your product might be published on FPT’s media platforms.

-Attend more than 80% of contact hours in order to be accepted to the final examination

- Actively participate in class activities

- Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class

- Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose

- Read the textbook in advance

- Access the course website (https://flm.fpt.edu.vn/) for up-to-date information and material of the course.

clos.loDetails: Demonstrate an understanding of the theories and practices involved in video production.
Master the methods to use a variety of lighting instruments, lighting support, grip, and equipment to demonstrate skills in lighting
Interpret the importance and impact of background on video quality and learn how to leverage video background
Demonstrate an understanding of the communicative capacity of video graphics to learn how to showcase an effective transference of ideas
Interpret the design and format of video and audio recording systems to control image quality
Master the mechanics of editing and the subtle effects of the editor’s choices to form a convincing, persuasive presentation
Define basic video production terms to understand the process of video production
Differentiate crew’s roles of the Film Production Team
Understand how people can organize the process of video production
Gain insight into necessary production techniques and their functions
Interpret the importance of script in production and the process of making script
Master camera main features and the methods of using camera to shoot videos
Master the methods to choose and motivate the actors
Demonstrate the ability to accomplish production tasks incorporating a practical understanding of audio production

assessments.gradingGuide:
Option 1:

(Presentation + Report)

For this group project, you will collaboratively produce a video based on a topical theme selected in class. The video will be screened in class and each group will lead a discussion on their theme.

The movie should demonstrate:

• That it is a justifiable representation of the theme selected in class

• Faithfulness to the original storyboards.

• The technique of in-camera editing.

• Basic technical video production skills, such as awareness of framing, lighting, etc.

The presentation (screening and discussion) should:

• Be facilitated in a communicative/commercial way.

• Be analytical of the topical theme.

• Direct the participants toward the generation of another theme.

The essay should:

• Should discuss a generative theme, link it to the topical theme, and demonstrate an understanding of media production

• Should explain the reason why the students decide to produce their video

• Should describe the content of the video (including its key message) and how the video can help them to spread the message to their target audiences

Notes: The detailed marking criteria for this assessment will be provided to you by your lecturer.

Option 2: (For Constructivism Approach only): Follow lecturer's proposal

assessments.gradingGuide:
Option 1:

Individual Project

For this individual project, you will get have the privilege to produce a video all by yourself based on the advice and suggestion of your lecturer. The video will be screened in class and you will the one who presents the idea and key message(s) behind your video and explain the reason why you decide to make this video.

Through the screening (presentation), the movie should demonstrate:

• A specific implicit/explicit key message

• Faithfulness to the original storyboards.

• The technique of in-camera editing.

• Basic technical video production skills

The essay should:

• Should demonstrate an understanding of video production

• Should explain the reason why the student decide to produce their video

• Should describe the content of the video (including its key message) and how the video can help them to spread the message to their target audiences

• Should evaluate the difference between working alone and working in a group

Notes:

Further details of the individual will be provided in class. The detailed marking criteria for this assessment will be provided to you by your lecturer.
